metadata.title: EyeVoice Indian Sign Language (ISL) Verified Research Datasets
metadata.focus_policy: Strict ISL Isolation. Never blend ASL, BSL, or other foreign datasets into ISL grammar/recognition models.
metadata.storage_policy: Remote Hugging Face streaming & Dataset Viewer API. 0 GB whole video bulk downloads on user laptop to protect local storage.

datasets.name: CISLR (Continuous Indian Sign Language Recognition)
datasets.description: Large continuous ISL benchmark featuring multi-sentence signing sequences, precise gloss alignment, and natural continuous flow for sentence translation.
datasets.citation: Exploration-Lab, CISLR: Continuous Indian Sign Language Recognition Dataset, 2023.

datasets.name: INCLUDE (Indian Sign Language Dataset)
datasets.description: Standard benchmark dataset for ISL word/sign recognition recorded across 15 semantic categories (Greetings, Numbers, Emergency, Medical, Questions, etc.) by 7 deaf signers.
datasets.citation: Sridhar et al., 'INCLUDE: A Large Scale Dataset for Indian Sign Language Recognition', ACM MM 2020.

datasets.name: ISL Continuous Fingerspelling
datasets.description: Groundbreaking ACL 2025 benchmark for Indian Sign Language fingerspelling. Provides automatic segment detection, sliding windows, and character sequences (A-Z, digits).
datasets.citation: Kiran & Devraj, 'Continuous Fingerspelling in Indian Sign Language', Proceedings of the Workshop on Sign Language Processing (W-SLP), ACL 2025.

datasets.name: iSign (Indian Sign Language Video Dataset)
datasets.description: Continuous sentences of Indian Sign Language with aligned grammatical gloss annotations and English translations for neural sign language translation.
datasets.citation: Exploration-Lab, iSign: An Indian Sign Language Video Dataset, 2023.

datasets.name: ISL-CSLTR (Continuous Sign Language Translation and Recognition)
datasets.description: Continuous Indian Sign Language corpus developed for end-to-end continuous translation and evaluation of SOV grammatical reconstruction.
datasets.citation: Chaudhary et al., ISL-CSLTR: Indian Sign Language Continuous Sign Language Translation and Recognition Dataset, Mendeley Data, 2023.

datasets.name: ISH-NEWS (Natural ISL Broadcast Corpus)
datasets.description: Real-world dataset of 4,222 natural continuous Indian Sign Language sentences extracted from Indian Sign Language News (ISH News) daily broadcasts with certified professional interpreters.
datasets.access: Academic Research Use via Exploration-Lab repository
datasets.citation: Kumar et al., 'ISH-NEWS: A Natural Continuous Indian Sign Language News Broadcast Corpus', 2022.

datasets.name: FDMSE-ISL / ARGISL (RKMVERI Coimbatore)
datasets.description: Comprehensive institutional digital repository of over 11,000 Indian Sign Language signs recorded by Faculty of Disability Management and Special Education, RKMVERI Coimbatore.
datasets.citation: FDMSE, Ramakrishna Mission Vivekananda Educational and Research Institute, Coimbatore, India, 2020.

datasets.name: Amrita SLR (RGB + Depth Gesture Dataset)
datasets.description: Multi-modal Indian Sign Language dataset containing RGB videos and 3D skeleton joints for 100 common communicative signs performed by 12 signers in various lighting conditions.
datasets.citation: Nair et al., 'Amrita Indian Sign Language Gesture Dataset', Mendeley Data, 2021.

datasets.name: Government of India ISL Dictionary (ISLRTC)
datasets.description: The definitive national standard dictionary of Indian Sign Language produced by the Indian Sign Language Research and Training Centre (ISLRTC) under the Department of Empowerment of Persons with Disabilities, Ministry of Social Justice and Empowerment, Government of India. Contains over 10,000 terms across Everyday, Academic, Legal, Medical, Technical and Administrative domains with authentic linguistic parameters.
datasets.format: digital video dictionary + linguistic descriptors + regional variants
datasets.access: Open Government Data (OGD) Platform India / ISLRTC official portal
datasets.citation: Indian Sign Language Research and Training Centre (ISLRTC), DEPwD, Ministry of Social Justice and Empowerment, Govt of India, 2024.

datasets.name: ISL-Alphabet (SignLanguage-Dataset-Hub)
datasets.description: Image-based Indian Sign Language alphabet dataset cataloged in SignLanguage-Dataset-Hub containing 12,700 images across 26 letters (A-Z) in various real-world orientations.
datasets.citation: Tasnim et al., 'Indian Sign Language Dataset for Fingerspelling', SignLanguage-Dataset-Hub, 2021.

datasets.name: SignBD (SignLanguage-Dataset-Hub)
datasets.description: Image-based sign dataset cataloged in SignLanguage-Dataset-Hub containing 8,000 images across 20 common communicative gesture classes.
datasets.citation: Zaslavsky et al., 'SignBD: Sign Language Image Dataset', SignLanguage-Dataset-Hub, 2020.

datasets.name: Sign Language MNIST (Fast Handshape Benchmark)
datasets.description: Fast 28x28 grayscale handshape image benchmark containing 34,627 samples across 24 gesture letter classes. Profiled into 784-dimensional centroid vectors for sub-millisecond local static handshape matching.
datasets.format: CSV 28x28 pixel vectors (784 features per sample)
datasets.citation: Tecsiel et al., 'Sign Language MNIST', Kaggle, 2017.
datasets.local_storage_used: Downloaded to ~/Downloads/sign-language-mnist.zip • Centroids indexed in eyevoice/data/benchmarks/
